query.text: 请帮我照看孩子，有危险或异常情况及时通知我。
query.text_en: Please help me watch the child and notify me immediately if there is any danger or abnormal situation.

annotation.text_zh: 学步车侧翻，宝宝摔倒了，快去看看！
annotation.text_en: The walker tipped over and the baby fell, go check on them!

annotation.text_zh: 姐姐已经抱起宝宝，宝宝正在大哭。
annotation.text_en: Big sister has picked up the baby, who is crying loudly.

annotation.text_zh: 姐姐抱着宝宝回屋了，宝宝还在哭。
annotation.text_en: Big sister carries the crying baby back into the room.
